reasoning: Official U.S. government reports and news organizations confirm that the U.S. gross national debt surpassed $34 trillion in late December 2023 / early January 2024. According to reporting from the U.S. House Committee on the Budget, PBS News, and CNBC, the national debt reached $34 trillion on December 29, 2023, and permanently crossed this threshold on January 4, 2024, growing further to $34.4 trillion by February 2024.
